message: No AI model is connected, so the Planner can't read your task yet. Start from one of these, or connect a model in Settings.

starters.name: Keep our software up to date
starters.what: Add the software your team runs. The Software watchlist checks each one for new releases, with one approval for all the upgrade tickets.

starters.name: Weekly summary of closed tickets
starters.what: Sum up the Jira tickets closed this week in one new ticket for the team.
starters.task: Every Friday at 4pm, find the tickets in MOCK closed this week and create one ticket that sums them up

starters.name: Follow up stale bug tickets
starters.what: Find bug tickets with no update for 10 days and list them in one follow-up ticket.
starters.task: Every weekday at 3pm, find bug tickets in MOCK with no update for 10 days and create one follow-up ticket that lists them
